blocks.raw: <ExamTip>LEA questions on History often provide a photograph or description of a building and ask you to identify its period, style, architect, or cultural tradition. Train yourself to read buildings visually: column types, arch forms, roof profiles, ornamental vocabulary, and material pleatte are all legible clues.</ExamTip>
